2608.14377.title: A Survey of Large Models in Sports
2608.14377.paper_summary: Sports have witnessed growing global enthusiasm in recent years, serving as a vital force for physical health, cultural exchange, social connection, and economic growth. The rapid advancement of large models, particularly (multimodal) large language models (M)LLMs, has demonstrated transformative potential to reshape sports understanding, analysis, and interaction across diverse domains. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of large models in sports, including (i) an overview of tasks and applications across different participant groups; (ii) a detailed analysis of sports-related datasets and benchmarks; and (iii) a critical discussion of current challenges and future directions. Our goal is to establish a foundation for advancing research and practical development of large-model-driven sports intelligence. An open-source GitHub repository is maintained at: https://github.com/Road2Redemption/Awesome_Large_Models_In_Sports1.
2608.14377.paper_summary_zh: 運動在近年來見證了全球日益增長的熱情，成為促進身體健康、文化交流、社會連結和經濟增長的重要力量。大型模型，特別是（多模態）大型語言模型（M）LLMs的快速發展，顯示出重塑運動理解、分析和互動的變革潛力，涵蓋多個領域。本文提供了運動領域中大型模型的綜合調查，包括（i）不同參與者群體的任務和應用概述；（ii）與運動相關的數據集和基準的詳細分析；以及（iii）對當前挑戰和未來方向的批判性討論。我們的目標是為推進大型模型驅動的運動智能的研究和實踐發展建立基礎。開源的GitHub倉庫維護於：https://github.com/Road2Redemption/Awesome_Large_Models_In_Sports1。
